A.scope: Separate source-bound primary-literature and catalog review followed by narrow documentation repairs.

A1.scope: Gravitation × discovery/parameter_inversion is newly occupied; PTAHellingsDowns occupies discovery/evidence.

nearby.difference: Measures angular correlations of many pulsars and claims a spatial kernel; this task fits a single waveform in two synthetic detectors and returns continuous parameters.
A fixed Doppler series contains planet/activity/alias periods; this task buys paired-detector samples and distinguishes coherent phase evolution from detector-localized signal.

Transit residuals with four future queries and a forecast; this task estimates two-channel transient frequency/slope/event time/amplitude with 24 measurements. Shared paid model selection is not the same physical observation family.

A2.repair: Task.md names PTA but only refers generically to microlensing. Name an actual repository neighbor, e.g. RadialVelocityPlanets, instead of implying an unnamed admitted microlensing task.

definite_error.actual_title: Binary Black Hole Mergers in the First Advanced LIGO Observing Run
definite_error.declared_title: Observing gravitational-wave transient GW150914 with minimal assumptions

A4.scope_gap: Task already declares reduced-order analogue; its current references are broader than the actual linear chirp dictionary. Add direct same-form precedent and make procedural time/noise/channel assumptions explicit.
A4.adequate_bounded_claim_after_repair: Synthetic waveform-family inference with a reduced linear-chirp/line/Gaussian-nuisance dictionary; not a full inspiral or physical LIGO source inference.

model_sources.supports: Section IV.1 LC test waveform is a constant-amplitude quadratic-phase chirp. Zero chirp rate is a sinusoid. Section II.1 describes Gaussian stationary noise.

model_sources.supports: Linear frequency variation as a reduced GW analysis dictionary.
Time-correlated transients across detectors with minimal morphology assumptions.
model_sources.does_not_establish: Fixed response scaling/no delay or a literal Gaussian detector glitch.

original_program_replays.fixed_selection: every original proposal, fixed seed order; no repair, replacement, or heldout selection

candidate_review.seed_0_counterexample_manual_review: Uses public problem values and charged observations, joint weighted sinusoid/chirp search and nuisance fitting. No hidden truth, file/network access or out-of-contract measurement source found. Candidate retained exactly as returned.
candidate_review.review_limit: Mechanism review of the actual passing first proposal plus AST/import checks for every original; not a general formal proof of arbitrary candidate safety.

D.difficulty_interpretation: One of three independent first proposals exceeds the frozen development reference, so D16 fails. All three identify every supported mechanism correctly (10/10 development and 12/12 heldout), while correct heldout refusal is only 1/4, 2/4 and 2/4. This bounded cohort shows weak refusal transfer and saturated supported-family identification for this model condition; it does not establish a broad difficulty distribution or long-horizon frontier hardness.
D.scientific_response: Hold admission. Preserve all original results and historical failures; no reference, world, budget, threshold, probe or candidate tuning and no additional draw used to reverse the result.

integration.report_only_followup: Only this package-external report is updated after D and replays. Package, prompt, contract and execution inputs remain the frozen ca7d261617 source. C stays bound to original e356f64f; no historical evidence re-signing.
